requirement: Import a non-empty JSON claim batch with a stable claim reference.
acceptance: Valid sample batch returns one result per item; untrackable envelopes exit 2.

requirement: Flag missing required details and wrong field types.
acceptance: Each missing required business field produces MISSING:<field>; invalid types remain reviewable.

requirement: Check the immutable policy snapshot, property and loss-date interval.
acceptance: Unknown policy, mismatched property and outside-period loss flag review; both period endpoints are included.

requirement: Validate dates and reporting chronology against an explicit evaluation date.
acceptance: Invalid ISO dates, loss after report and future dates are flagged.

requirement: Validate loss type and integer-cent amount; escalate high value.
acceptance: Only water/fire/theft/wind and 1..1,000,000,000 cents are valid; at least 2,500,000 cents flags review.
Water/fire/wind require photos; theft requires inventory and police_reference; absent labels flag review.
Same exact reference and canonical JSON returns the same ID and original decision without new audit events.

requirement: Detect reference conflicts and possible duplicate losses without deleting either record.
acceptance: Changed same-reference payload flags conflict; different reference with same known policy, valid loss date and type flags possible duplicate.

requirement: Route all flags to human review and clean claims to an adjuster.
acceptance: Any nonempty reason list means NEEDS_REVIEW; no flags means READY_FOR_ADJUSTER, never approval.

requirement: Persist payloads, decisions and actor-stamped audit events.
acceptance: Records survive reopening the SQLite file; intake and review events include actor, timestamp and details.

requirement: Record one explicit human triage action per flagged record.
acceptance: Only request_information/refer_adjuster/close_duplicate are accepted; closing needs a duplicate flag; no action approves payment.

requirement: Show pending review work and reconcilable routing counts.
acceptance: Pending queue excludes reviewed records; flagged plus ready equals total and reviewed plus pending equals flagged.

requirement: Keep batch writes atomic and duplicate detection serialized.
acceptance: Malformed input or storage failure leaves no partial claims/audit; conflicting writers cannot bypass the write lock.

requirement: Generate an executed requirement-level QA report.
acceptance: Every requirement has executed passing tests; failed, skipped or untested requirements prevent overall PASS.

requirement: Recalculate a three-option decision model and review-rate sensitivity.
acceptance: Documented assumptions reproduce cost, capacity and sensitivity outputs without presenting estimates as measurements.
